:::{#exm-ci-prob}

#### Confidence interval for a beetle mortality probability

For the `beetles` [logistic regression model](#def-logistic-regression) (`beetles_glm_ungrouped`),
the code below first computes a 95% confidence interval for the log-odds at dose 1.8,
then applies $\expit$ to its endpoints as in @thm-ci-prob:

```{r}
#| label: exm-ci-prob-calc
#| code-fold: show
ex_pred <- predict(
  beetles_glm_ungrouped,
  newdata = data.frame(dose = 1.8),
  type = "link",
  se.fit = TRUE
)
ex_ci_logodds <- ex_pred$fit + c(-1, 1) * 1.96 * ex_pred$se.fit
ex_ci_prob <- plogis(ex_ci_logodds)
```

The 95% confidence interval for the log-odds is
(`r round(ex_ci_logodds[1], 3)`, `r round(ex_ci_logodds[2], 3)`),
so the 95% confidence interval for the probability of death is
(`r round(ex_ci_prob[1], 3)`, `r round(ex_ci_prob[2], 3)`),
which stays inside $(0, 1)$ and contains the estimate `r round(plogis(ex_pred$fit), 3)`.

:::
